title: Compatible lifting along one monomorphism of split injective towers
statement: For a tower I of injective abelian groups with split transition maps, every morphism g:A→I extends along every monomorphism f:A→B of towers.

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 proof footnote, compatible lifting induction

proof.text: The components of a monomorphism of towers are monomorphisms by Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.FunctorCategory.EpiMono. Use Injective.factorThru at level zero to construct a component extending g_0.

Given h_n extending g_n, put p = I(n+1 to n), s = section_(p), b = B(n+1 to n) followed by h_n, and t = Injective.factorThru(g_(n+1), f_(n+1)). Define h_(n+1) = t + (b - t followed by p) followed by s. Naturality gives f_(n+1) followed by b = g_(n+1) followed by p. Thus the correction vanishes on A_(n+1). Since s followed by p is the identity, h_(n+1) followed by p = b. These are the extension and adjacent compatibility equalities.

Use Nat.rec to construct the sequence of extending components, carrying the extension equation in a subtype. Adjacent compatibility follows from the successor formula. Apply Mathlib NatTrans.ofOpSequence to obtain a natural transformation compatible with all tower maps, and NatTrans.ext to prove f followed by h = g.
